text:
Devon Price: Heads up: per last week’s pilot plan, I want to flip error budget gates from warn-only -> soft-block for the first set of services (API gateway + routing + control plane deploy pipeline step). Target: tomorrow 10am PT. Any objections / last checks?

Sahana Iyer: +1 to moving. Soft-block = gate fails the stage unless override token is provided, right? (vs hard-block where override is disabled)

Benji Okafor: Yep. Soft-block behavior in `deploy-gate`:
- budgets healthy -> pass
- budgets at-risk/exhausted -> fail, but can proceed w/ `--override-token` + reason (audited)
- missing budget data -> treat as FAIL (same as at-risk) (this is the part I’m most nervous about)

Ethan Park: Agree on missing budget data. Can we make “missing data” behave as WARN for the first week? If the cron hiccups, we’ll end up blocking everything.

Rafael Mendes: SRE perspective: missing data should be “fail closed” eventually, but ok to do a short grace period. I’d rather block on “exhausted” and “fast burn” first.

Jordan Lee: Policy engine config already supports the matrix. We can set:
- `exhausted` => soft-block
- `fast_burn` (multiwindow alert firing) => soft-block
- `no_data` => warn-only (TEMP)
If we do this, can we write it down so it doesn’t live forever?

Devon Price: Works for me. Let’s timebox `no_data => warn` to 7 days. Connor ok from change mgmt?

Connor O'Brien: Fine w/ timebox, but only if there’s a checklist + explicit rollback. Also: announce in #eng-oncall and #eng-sre before the flip.

Mina Haddad: For routing, we need to ensure the gate is scoped correctly. We don’t want Dedicated to get blocked because Hosted is burning (and vice versa). Can someone confirm the query is `tier=...` scoped?

Aisha Bello: Confirmed in the budget-check API payload: `tier`, `service`, `region`. The gating rule we’re enabling for routing uses `tier=hosted` + service names `routing`, `policy-engine`.
Also pls note: we still have one gap on streaming disconnect SLI correctness in `us-east-1` but it should only affect the Hosted “availability” SLI slightly.

Sahana Iyer: What’s the exact set for Day 1?

Devon Price: Proposal Day 1 soft-block set:
1) `api-gateway`
2) `routing`
3) `policy-engine`
4) `control-plane` (deploy pipeline gate step only, not runtime deploys yet)

Cole Summers: Does `api-gateway` include the rate limit service? Asking because protective throttling toggle is wired there too.

Benji Okafor: Gate integration point is in the deploy pipeline, so it affects any deploys of those services. Doesn’t auto-toggle throttling. That’s separate.

Ethan Park: Checklist we should hit before flipping:
- [ ] budget computation job healthy (last run < 10m)
- [ ] dashboards populated (Hosted + Dedicated) and filters work
- [ ] override tokens tested end-to-end and show up in audit log
- [ ] runbook linked in gate output
- [ ] canary pipeline handles gate failure gracefully (doesn’t leave partial rollout)
- [ ] alert routing for burn alerts already paging correct oncall

Rafael Mendes: Add:
- [ ] verify budget scope for each service (tier/service/region) matches SLO config
- [ ] verify “no_data” state currently low/zero for last 24h (or we’ll spam)

Mina Haddad: Add:
- [ ] routing deploy rollback path confirmed (we’ve got the old fallback policy pack pinned)

Connor O'Brien: Add:
- [ ] comms template: what to do when your deploy is blocked (who to ping, what screenshots to attach)

Sahana Iyer: I can run the override test in staging today. What command are we standardizing on?

Benji Okafor: For deployctl:
`deployctl promote --service routing --env prod --gate error-budget`
If blocked:
`deployctl promote ... --override-token $TOKEN --override-reason "SEV2 mitigation for incident INC-####"`
Override is TTL’d (defaults 2h) + logs to `control-plane/audit`.

Aisha Bello: And “who can mint a token” is restricted to oncall + eng managers for now. Rafael/Sean wanted a tight list initially.

Ethan Park: Re: missing data grace period — how do we enforce the 7-day sunset?

Jordan Lee: I can add an expiring policy rule in config with an `expires_at`. It will flip `no_data` to soft-block automatically after date. (We already do this for feature flags.)

Devon Price: Nice. Do that.

DeployBot: devon.price started a deployment plan change request: `error_budget_gate_mode: warn_only -> soft_block` (scope: api-gateway,routing,policy-engine,control-plane) (scheduled: 2025-01-30 10:00 PT)

Sahana Iyer: One more thing: do we want “soft-block” to apply only to prod deploys, or also staging? Staging blocks are annoying.

Benji Okafor: Prod only. Staging remains warn-only so teams can validate fixes even when prod is frozen.

Rafael Mendes: +1. We still want staging signals though.

Devon Price: OK, action items:
- Sahana: run override token E2E in staging + paste output
- Jordan: add `no_data warn` rule w/ `expires_at` = +7d
- Benji: confirm gate output includes runbook link + shows scoped tier/service/region
- Mina: confirm routing scope + rollback notes
- Devon: post comms in #eng-oncall + #eng-sre + update pilot doc

Mina Haddad: Confirmed routing scope: gate hits `/budget-check?tier=hosted&service=routing&region=ALL` for routing deploys. Dedicated routing deploys use `tier=dedicated`. We’re good.

Sahana Iyer: Staging test results:
`deployctl promote --service routing --env prod --gate error-budget`
-> BLOCKED as expected:
`budget_status=EXHAUSTED (remaining=-0.7%) window=30d slo=99.9%`
Then override:
`deployctl promote ... --override-token **** --override-reason "hotfix for alert noise"`
-> PASSED, and I see the record in audit with reason + my user. :thumbsup:

Connor O'Brien: Great. Please include a reminder in comms: overrides require incident/bug link and are reviewed weekly.

Aisha Bello: Also: if you’re blocked due to `fast_burn`, please don’t override blindly. It usually means an ongoing regression. Check the burn dashboard + top error contributors first.

Devon Price: Copy that. I’ll draft comms with:
- what soft-block means
- when to request override (mitigation / critical fix)
- what info to include (service, tier, region, dashboard link, PR link)
- rollback steps

Ethan Park: Any concerns about gating the control plane deploy itself? If control plane is blocked, we can’t ship gate fixes.

Benji Okafor: Good catch: control-plane gating is scoped to “non-emergency” pipelines. There’s an `--break-glass` path for SRE (separate from override token) that bypasses budget checks entirely, but requires #eng-sre approval + is always audited. (We should be clear we’re not using it for normal work.)

Rafael Mendes: That’s fine, but pls don’t advertise break-glass broadly.

Devon Price: Agreed. We’ll keep break-glass in the runbook only.

Jordan Lee: Config change for `no_data` expiring rule is ready, will merge shortly. Expiration set to 2025-02-06 10:00 PT.

Devon Price: Great. Unless new blockers show up, we’re flipping tomorrow at 10am PT. I’ll post checklist completion + links in this thread before the change.
